title: Revit workflows and connector status
description: Explore Revit building workflows with Vector OS, from a design brief to coordinated review. Revit is available in the beta; Dynamo is in development.
html:
Software
Revit · AvailableDynamo · In development

Vector OS for Revit + Dynamo.

Explore a building from its first brief to a coordinated review.

Start with the brief

Create a two-storey courtyard learning-centre concept with three northlight roofs, generous glazing and timber screens.

A two-storey concept makes one courtyard and three rear northlights identifiable.

What changes in this example?

A selectable brief and an original sketch of this exact building align with the same source-derived massing. Brief and Reference change how the input is presented while the courtyard project remains fixed.

Changed

  • Input presentation changes between the authored brief and matching reference

  • The baseline massing is revealed from the same source geometry

Retained

  • 42 by 30 metre footprint around a 20 by 12 metre courtyard

  • Two storeys

  • Three rear northlights

  • Entrance orientation

Concept model preview; no native RVT is claimed.

Read the steps

  • Read the two-storey courtyard brief or inspect its matching sketch.

  • Align the sketch with the baseline massing camera.

  • Reveal the courtyard void, two levels and three northlights as one concept model.

Align the request to the building concept

Tools and availability

Revit

Building elements, model data and document views.

Dynamo

Inputs and repeatable logic around the model.

Vector OS

A request alongside the model change and its review.

Connector status: Available. Revit is available in the Vector OS beta. Dynamo integration is in development; it does not inherit Revit availability.

Revit: Available. Revit is available in the Vector OS beta. Dynamo integration is in development; it does not inherit Revit availability.

Dynamo: In development. Dynamo integration is in development. Revit availability does not establish Dynamo feature support.

Check current availability

What does Dynamo add to this workflow?

Dynamo makes the inputs and repeatable steps visible. In this example, those steps connect the selected canopy, its current projection and the proposed value.

Does the page change a Revit model?

The page is a local workflow preview. Using your own project will depend on the released connector and its supported Revit and Dynamo versions.

Will the drawings reflect the selected revision?

The preview derives its model views and values from the same concept configuration. Actual project drawings need the appropriate model, view setup and review.

When will Revit and Dynamo be available?

Connector status: Available. Revit is available in the Vector OS beta. Dynamo integration is in development; it does not inherit Revit availability.
